name: Papirfabrikken Invest A/S
summary: Established in 1917 and headquartered in Silkeborg, Denmark, Papirfabrikken Invest A/S manages a diverse range of operations through its subsidiaries. The company is primarily involved in running a professional football club, real estate development and management, and hotel services across Denmark. Beyond these core areas, Papirfabrikken Invest A/S also supports talent growth through dedicated development programs, handles merchandise and concession sales, organizes conference events, and leases out its various properties. The firm adopted its current name in January 2024, having previously been known as Silkeborg IF Invest A/S.
